newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks barely changed, HSBC features.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks barely changed, HSBC features.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were barely changed on Friday after a volatile day which featured HSBC Holdings as the most active stock.
"There has not been an awful lot going on," said a trader. "But it has been quite volatile after a weak Hong Kong close."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 1.96 points at 12,390.34 by 1415 GMT.
In Hong Kong on Friday, the Hang Seng lost 85-points.
"We opened reasonably steady in London and HSBC started going ahead with the FTSE which took a few shares with it," one dealer said.
HSBC Holdings was trading at $157.25 in London after a Hong Kong close of $156.00. By 1415 GMT the FTSE 100 index was up 23.4 points at 4,022.8.
"We were stopped in our tracks when the figures came out in the States," the dealer said. U.S. September durable goods orders came in stronger-than-expected.
"But when the market came down we started to see some buyers, especially in HSBC and a few other banks." he said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
